entries.description: An intentional community on 22 acres run by 2 lesbians, focusing on bees, honey, rare poultry, organic agriculture, and beekeeping/Permaculture apprenticeships. They welcome other lesbians and are accompanied by various animals.
entries.raw_text: oriented homestead whose main farm income is from sales of bees and honey and from hatching rare breeds of poultry. Off-farm income is derived from graphic design, photography and writing for the organic agriculture journals. We also produce and sell lesbian/feminist t-shirts and rubber stamps under the name of Armadillo Mountain. Would welcome correspondence with other lesbians on the land. Longer-term apprenticeships/work exchanges are a possibility. Would also trade apprenticeships in beekeeping and Permaculture (particularly dryland and forage systems) for some good, solid vocational skills, especially carpentry and stone masonry. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 22 acres, good tools and equipment, dogs, cats, chickens, ducks, guineas, peabirds and 60 zillion bees.
entries.notes: Continues previous page. Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative as they live on the land and run an integrated homestead. Acreage is 22. Num residents is 2 lesbians. Accepted groups: lesbian women ('other lesbians'). Focuses: Farming/self-sufficiency ('main farm income is from sales of bees and honey', 'farming'), Environmentalism/eco-friendly ('organic agriculture', 'Permaculture').

entries.description: An intentional community on 147 acres in Days Creek, Oregon, maintained by 2 lesbians. It offers housing, camping space, and farm land, and welcomes new members, caretakers, women, and children.
entries.raw_text: OWL FARM POB 133, Days Creek, OR 97429. We are two wimmin caretaking OWL since Aug 82. OWL is needing energy and money support from wimmin to stay open for wimmin & children. No abuse of alcohol, drugs, or violence. I encourage wimmin of color to come and be here. We welcome: new members/caretakers, girl children, boy children (under 10 years), nonlesbian women, dogs only if restrained, donations. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 147 acres, housing/permanent structures, camping space, woods, farm land, wimmin living and working the land. Inactive group with hopes to revive.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because it is an established community ("caretaking OWL", "housing/permanent structures"). Acreage is 147. Num residents is 2. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (inferred from 'wimmin'), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children ('girl children'), Boy children ('boy children'). Focuses: none (mention of wimmin of color is inclusiveness/encouragement, not a strict focus).

entries.description: A land trust supporting OWL Farm, managed by a collective of women. Welcomes new members, girls, boys, and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: OREGON WOMEN'S LAND TRUST PO Box 1692, Roseburg, OR 97470. OWLT is in the process of buying OWL FARM (see above). Support for the farm and trust comes from donations from those women who believe in land for women. A quarterly newsletter is printed, $5/year. Land trust meetings are held about every three months at the farm. A collective of women (the number fluctuates) caretakes the farm. We welcome: new members, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women.
entries.notes: Type is Land Trust ('Land Trust'). Acreage not given for the trust as a whole (OWL Farm acreage is mentioned above but not quantified for the trust itself here). Num residents not given ('number fluctuates'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women (inferred from 'women'), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children ('girl children'), Boy children ('boy children').

entries.description: An intentional community of 4 lesbians on 40 acres in Myrtle Creek, Oregon. They host workshops in Theatre and Tai Chi, and focus on emotional/spiritual depth and women's art and song.
entries.raw_text: FLY AWAY HOME POB 593, Myrtle Creek, OR 97457. We are a family of 4 lesbians living on a secluded forest hilltop. We grow food and tender our emotional and spiritual depths. And we make art and song that celebrate woman. We invite women to our workshops in Theatre and in Tai Chi several times during the year. We are unable to welcome visitors at other times. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 40 acres, housing/permanent structures, woods, farm land, women living and working the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative ('4 lesbians living on a secluded forest hilltop'). Acreage is 40. Num residents is 4. Accepted groups: Lesbian women ('lesbians', 'women'). Focuses: Workshops/education ('workshops in Theatre and in Tai Chi'), Spirituality/ritual ('emotional and spiritual depths').

entries.description: A partnership of 2 lesbians on 130 acres of forested property in Roseburg, Oregon. They practice sustainable wood management via thinning and reforestation, and welcome women, children, and male friends.
entries.raw_text: STEPPING WOODS Rt 4 Box 1058, Roseburg, OR 97470. We are a partnership of 2 lesbians owning 130 acres of forested property. We manage our woods by thinning and reforestation, where necessary, for selective timber harvest and firewood. There is one woman-built cabin, a few out buildings, a garden, chickens, and pets. We are not separatists and have male friends that come on our land. We welcome: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 130 acres, housing/permanent structures, electricity/privy, camping space, woods, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative ('partnership of 2 lesbians owning 130 acres'). Acreage is 130. Num residents is 2. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (inferred from 'lesbians'), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children ('girl children'), Boy children ('boy children'), Non-gay men ('male friends that come on our land' - assuming non-gay since they are male friends of a lesbian land partnership). Focuses: Environmentalism/eco-friendly ('manage our woods by thinning and reforestation').

entries.description: A rural feminist publishing center run by two older lesbians (57 and 60 years old) on 6+ acres in Sunny Valley, Oregon. Focuses on publishing Woman spirit and The Blantant Image, and alternative technology. Welcomes women of all ages.
entries.raw_text: ROOTWORKS 2000 King Mountain Trail, Sunny Valley, OR 97497. A rural feminist publishing center (Womanspirit and The Blatant Image) with strong interests in photography, (summer Ovulars), ecology and alternative technology. We are 57 & 60 years old. We enjoy the company and help of women of all ages who can adapt to our simple lifestyle for short or long visits. Rules: no men, guns, pets, drugs or dope. Smoking limited to outdoors gravel area. $4/day/woman includes vegetarian meals. We welcome: nonlesbian women, women to help on projects. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 6+ acres, housing/permanent structures, outdoor toilets, electricity with generator and batteries, camping space, woods, gardens, women living and working with the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative ('2 lesbians... women living and working with the land'). Acreage is 6. Num residents is 2. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (inferred from 'women'), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'). Focuses: Archives/cultural work ('publishing center (Womanspirit and The Blatant Image)'), Older women ('We are 57 & 60 years old').

entries.land_location_as_stated: Provincetown, a resort area on the tip of Cape Cod
entries.description: A women's guesthouse located in Provincetown, Massachusetts on Cape Cod. Offers rooms and apartments, and welcomes women, children, and men during the off-season.
entries.raw_text: GABRIEL'S 104 Bradford St, Provincetown, MA 02657 (617)487-3232. Gabriel's is a women's guesthouse located in the center of Provincetown, a resort area on the tip of Cape Cod. We are one block from the nearest beach, have both rooms and apartments, private and shared baths, TVs, a common room, coffee and toast, hot tub and garden patio. Call or write for descriptive brochure. We welcome: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, males (during off season only, Nov-March). We have/are: housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space ('women\'s guesthouse'). Acreage not given. Num residents not given. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (inferred from 'women\'s guesthouse'), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children ('girl children'), Boy children ('boy children'), Non-gay men ('males (during off season only, Nov-March)' - assumed non-gay as default for males unless specified).

entries.land_location_as_stated: an island off the coast of Maine
entries.description: A womyn's rooming/guest house situated on an island off the coast of Maine, run by 2 lesbians. Offers a large Victorian house with rooms for rent.
entries.raw_text: SEA GNOMES HOME Box 33, Stonington, ME 04681 (207)367-5376. We are a womyn's rooming/guest house situated on a large island off the coast of Maine. Rooms are $21 including tax. The house is a large Victorian, partially restored, one bathroom, kitchen use, large parlour. We welcome: girl children, nonlesbian women. We are/are: 2 lesbians, 1 dog, 1 cat, house, plumbing/electricity.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space ('womyn\'s rooming/guest house'). Acreage not given. Num residents is 2 lesbians. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (inferred from 'womyn\'s'), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children ('girl children'). Note: 'We are/are:' is printed as such in raw text.

entries.description: Notice of legal dissolution of multiple-ownership land holding.
entries.raw_text: OZARK WIMMIN'S LAND TRUST PO Box 718, Fayetteville, AR 72702. We have tried multiple-ownership (partnership) type of land holding. The pieces of land wound up in legal dissolution eventually. Some of us persevere in the spirit. We cannot guarantee to answer letters, but if you are prepared to spend a little time in the area, a land search may be fruitful. A large wimmin's community exists.
entries.notes: Not a listing, land wound up in legal dissolution.
